name: Token Accountant
tagline: Watches your weekly model spend and warns you well before the allowance runs out
description: Nobody notices a budget draining until the week it stops working. This reads the weekly figures off your Cursor spending page, separates them out by where the money actually went, and puts a note in front of each owner at a quarter, a half, three quarters and nine tenths of what they are allowed.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
